name: Vitamin B12 (Methylcobalamin)
summary: Vitamin B12 (Cobalamin) is an essential water-soluble organometallic cofactor required for methionine synthase and methylmalonyl-CoA mutase. It plays an indispensable role in DNA synthesis, myelin sheath maintenance, and red blood cell erythropoiesis.

dosage_guide.standard_dose: 500mcg - 1000mcg daily or sublingual

safety_data.upper_limit: No established UL (excess excreted in urine)
safety_data.side_effects: Rare acneiform eruptions at massive doses (>2000mcg)

effect_matrix.clinical_notes: Essential methyl group donor for remethylating toxic homocysteine into methionine.
Promotes myelin synthesis and nerve regeneration in diabetic and nutritional neuropathies.
Resolves macrocytic megaloblastic anemia and cellular hypoxia in deficiency.

studies.title: Lowering blood homocysteine with folic acid based supplements: meta-analysis of randomised trials
Methylcobalamin in the treatment of diabetic neuropathy

name: Vitamin B6 (Pyridoxal-5-Phosphate / P-5-P)
summary: Pyridoxal-5-Phosphate is the active coenzymatic form of Vitamin B6. It serves as an essential cofactor for over 140 enzymatic reactions, including aromatic L-amino acid decarboxylase, synthesizing GABA, serotonin, dopamine, epinephrine, and heme.

dosage_guide.standard_dose: 25mg - 50mg daily

safety_data.side_effects: Peripheral sensory neuropathy if dosed >200mg/day long-term

effect_matrix.clinical_notes: Regulates luteal phase progesterone/estrogen balance and dopamine synthesis.
First-line clinical intervention for mild-to-moderate hyperemesis gravidarum.

studies.title: Efficacy of vitamin B-6 in the treatment of premenstrual syndrome: systematic review

name: Vitamin C (Ascorbic Acid)
summary: Vitamin C is a water-soluble electron donor that functions as an essential enzymatic cofactor for prolyl and lysyl hydroxylases in collagen biosynthesis, carnitine production, and catecholamine neurotransmitter synthesis. It also recycles oxidized alpha-tocopherol (Vitamin E).

dosage_guide.standard_dose: 500mg - 1000mg daily
dosage_guide.optimal_timing: Divided with morning and evening meals
dosage_guide.forms: Ascorbic Acid, Liposomal Vitamin C, Calcium Ascorbate (Ester-C)

safety_data.side_effects: Osmotic diarrhea and gastric cramps at doses >2000mg
safety_data.contraindications: Hemochromatosis (increases iron absorption), oxalate kidney stones

effect_matrix.clinical_notes: Mandatory cofactor for cross-linking triple helix procollagen fibers.
Cochrane meta-analysis confirms halved respiratory infection rates in extreme physical stress.
Protects tetrahydrobiopterin (BH4) from oxidation, preserving eNOS coupling.

studies.title: Vitamin C for preventing and treating the common cold
Ascorbic acid prevents vascular endothelial dysfunction during acute hyperhomocysteinemia
